title: Ask for missing information honestly
summary: A good request says what to do when evidence is missing. An answer such as not provided can be more useful than an invented detail.
introduction: A good request says what to do when evidence is missing. An answer such as not provided can be more useful than an invented detail. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain ask for missing information honestly
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A good request says what to do when evidence is missing. An answer such as not provided can be more useful than an invented detail.

blocks.code:
Source: Sports club meets on Monday.
Question: What time does it meet?
Rule: If the source does not say, answer Not provided.
blocks.title: Ask for missing information honestly

blocks.text: The expected answer is Not provided. The source gives a day but no time.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a time to the source and update the expected answer.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not reward a complete-looking answer when the evidence is incomplete.
For more detail later, use this [Prompt Engineering further reading](https://www.promptingguide.ai/introduction).
